# v1.0.0 — First major release: a doc-generation CLI on top of the pi kernel

> **zread-pi 1.0.0**: generates a Notion-style DeepWiki documentation site for your repository.
> The business layer (three-stage blueprint / parallel page generation / style discipline / global memory) runs on top of pi's agent kernel
> (`@earendil-works/pi-ai` + `pi-agent-core`, consumed as vendored source + dist artifacts, zero upstream changes);
> the CLI is a full-screen pi-tui TUI (zero React dependencies).

## ✨ Core capabilities

| Capability | Details |
|---|---|
| **Three-stage blueprint** | Classify (Repo Map global analysis) → topics (1 agent per section, p-limit concurrency) → titles (refined write-back); slugs / filenames / numbering assigned centrally by code, URLs never drift; a failed section doesn't block the rest; each stage persists incrementally (file lock + atomic replace) |
| **Parallel page generation** | `write_page` tool persists to disk + Mermaid validation gate; failed pages are recorded as `page_error` with their last usage snapshot |
| **Token budget & compaction** | Turn limits convert into a token budget (usage-ledger authoritative accumulation) with two-phase budget prompts; harness-built-in compaction (summary + recent messages kept); overflow is classified as `error_context_full` |
| **File & search tools** | `Read` / `Write` / `Edit` / `Glob` / `Grep` / `Ls`, rewritten with upstream pi semantics; rg / fd are probed at runtime and installed only explicitly (config UI or `tools:install`), with pure-JS fallback when missing |
| **Image pipeline** | `Read` normalizes images to png/jpeg/gif/webp, auto-scales oversized ones, includes coordinate-conversion notes; photon WASM runs in a Worker thread with in-process fallback |
| **Two-layer style discipline** | Preventive layer: humanizer discipline appended to system prompts (zero extra calls); fallback layer: `polish.mode=full` per-page polish agent (reverts broken Mermaid, failures never fail the page) |
| **Repo self-description injection** | Reads `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` etc. and injects them as `<project_context>` into blueprint and page agents |
| **Incremental sync** | After a file diff, only affected sections are patched; unaffected page URLs never drift; no LLM calls when nothing changed |
| **Global memory history** | ZRH1 binary format (`~/.zread-pi/history`); `zread-pi history` prunes stale projects and lists the rest |
| **Browse docs** | API + static assets on one port (SPA fallback); in-process Vite fallback when running from source without build artifacts — no more manual `browse:dev` |
| **Provider ecosystem** | pi-ai's built-in catalog of 40 providers + custom model merging; API keys go through `Models.login('api_key')` into `~/.zread-pi/auth.json`; 7 thinking levels |

## 🖥️ CLI configuration UI (pi-tui)

Under `/config`: provider details (API key + model side by side), thinking level `/config/thinking`,
max turns `/config/max-turns` (0 = unlimited), style polish `/config/polish`, external tools `/config/tools` (install with progress bar).

## 📦 Install

```bash
# Option 1: standalone binary (zip attached to this release, unzip and run)
#   zread-pi-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# Option 2: from source
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli config
bun run cli
```

## ✅ Verification (all from real runs)

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `bun run typecheck` | 0 errors |
| `bun run test` (full) | all green: catalog 34, agent 19, tools 102, installer 70, history 61+24+10, lock 10, http 12, provider 5, analyzer 5+17, blueprint 27+19+11+17, pages 16+7+16, context 45, tui 209+9+10+26+28+31+28 |
| `bun run mock:wiki` | `completed=6 failed=0` (hello-python fixture) |

## ⚠️ Known limits

- No full wiki generation has been run with a real API key yet (all verification used faux / mock HTTP); for the first real run, `bun run cli config` then try a small repository;
- The OAuth login UI has been removed (config UI offers API key only; OAuth credentials can be hand-written into `auth.json`, flow not verified on a real machine);
- MCP / Skill / Task / Team / LSP / Bash and other shell tools are not migrated;
- The bottom usage totals exclude polish-agent usage under `polish.mode=full`;
- The standalone binary needs `photon_rs_bg.wasm` shipped alongside the `tools/build-binary.ts` artifacts; without it images degrade to text notes (no error).

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/alem0n/zread-pi/compare/v0.15.0...v1.0.0

# v1.0.0 —— 首个主版本：pi 内核之上的文档生成 CLI

> **zread-pi 1.0.0**：给仓库生成 Notion 风格的 DeepWiki 文档站。
> 业务层（三阶段蓝图 / 并行页面生成 / 文风纪律 / 全局记忆）运行在 pi 的 agent 内核之上
> （`@earendil-works/pi-ai` + `pi-agent-core`，vendor 源码 + dist 产物消费，上游零改动），
> CLI 为 pi-tui 全屏 TUI（零 React 依赖）。

## ✨ 核心能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **三阶段蓝图生成** | 分类（Repo Map 全局分析）→ 分主题（每分类 1 Agent，p-limit 并发）→ 标题（精修回写）；slug / 文件名 / 编号由代码统一分配，URL 不漂移；单分类失败不阻断，每阶段增量落盘（文件锁 + 原子替换） |
| **并行页面生成** | `write_page` 工具落盘 + Mermaid 校验拦截；失败页记录 `page_error` 并带最后一次用量快照 |
| **token 预算与上下文压缩** | 轮数硬顶折算为 token 预算（usage ledger 权威累计），两段式预算提示；harness 内建压缩（摘要 + 保留近期消息），溢出归类 `error_context_full` |
| **文件与搜索工具** | `Read` / `Write` / `Edit` / `Glob` / `Grep` / `Ls`，按上游 pi 语义重写；rg / fd 探测常驻、安装显式（配置界面或 `tools:install`），缺失时纯 JS 兜底 |
| **图片处理管线** | `Read` 图片归一到 png/jpeg/gif/webp、超限自动缩放、坐标换算提示；Worker 线程跑 photon WASM，失败回退进程内 |
| **文风纪律两层机制** | 预防层：humanizer 纪律拼进系统提示（零额外调用）；兜底层：`polish.mode=full` 页面级润色 Agent（Mermaid 改坏回滚、失败不判页失败） |
| **目标仓库自述注入** | 读取 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` 等以 `<project_context>` 注入蓝图与页面 Agent |
| **增量同步** | 文件 diff 后只修补受影响分类，未受影响页面 URL 不漂移，无变更不调 LLM |
| **全局记忆 history** | ZRH1 二进制（`~/.zread-pi/history`），`zread-pi history` 清理失效项目并列出剩余 |
| **浏览文档** | API + 静态资源同端口（SPA fallback），源码运行无产物时进程内 Vite 兜底，不再依赖手动 `browse:dev` |
| **Provider 生态** | pi-ai 内置 40 Provider 目录 + 自定义模型合并；API Key 走 `Models.login('api_key')` 落 `~/.zread-pi/auth.json`；思考深度 7 档 |

## 🖥️ CLI 配置界面（pi-tui）

`/config` 下维护：Provider 详情（API Key + 模型并列）、思考深度 `/config/thinking`、
最大轮次 `/config/max-turns`（0 = 不限制）、文风润色 `/config/polish`、外部工具 `/config/tools`（安装带进度条）。

## 📦 安装

```bash
# 方式一：standalone 二进制（本 Release 附带的 zip，解压即用）
#   zread-pi-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip / linux-x64 / macos-arm64

# 方式二：从源码运行
bun install
bun run vendor:build
bun run cli config
bun run cli
```

## ⚠️ 已知边界

- 未用真实 API Key 跑过完整 wiki 生成（全部验证基于 faux / mock HTTP）；首次真机建议 `bun run cli config` 后在目标仓库试跑小仓库；
- OAuth 登录界面已移除（配置界面只提供 API Key；OAuth 凭据可手写 `auth.json`，流程未真机验证）；
- MCP / Skill / Task / Team / LSP / Bash 等 shell 工具未迁移；
- 生成页底部用量合计不含 `polish.mode=full` 的 polish Agent 用量；
- standalone 二进制需随 `tools/build-binary.ts` 产物分发 `photon_rs_bg.wasm`，缺失时图片退化为文本说明（不报错）。

**完整变更**：https://github.com/alem0n/zread-pi/compare/v0.15.0...v1.0.0
